beats.narration_text: A quantum particle travels as a little blob of waves — a moving lump full of ripples.

beats.narration_text: Watch closely and the ripples inside slide backward, even as the blob races forward.

beats.narration_text: Here's the packet: a smooth envelope holding a train of wave crests.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Here's the packet: a smooth envelope holding a train of wave crests.
beats.new_visual_element: a static Gaussian envelope outline with internal wave crests
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a dashed Gaussian envelope (above and below) and the oscillating wave filling it, centred and static

beats.narration_text: The envelope is where the particle actually is, and it glides forward at the particle's speed.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The envelope is where the particle actually is, and it glides forward at the particle's speed.
beats.new_visual_element: the whole packet begins moving to the right (envelope speed)
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: start the continuous motion — the packet (envelope + crests) translates rightward at the group velocity

beats.narration_text: Tag one crest with a dot and watch it against the moving envelope.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Tag one crest with a dot and watch it against the moving envelope.
beats.new_visual_element: a red dot pinned to one crest, riding the wave
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: place a red dot on one crest; it rides the carrier at the phase velocity as the packet keeps moving

beats.narration_text: The crest moves forward too, but only half as fast as the envelope.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The crest moves forward too, but only half as fast as the envelope.
beats.new_visual_element: a speed legend: a long envelope arrow and a half-length crest arrow
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: show a small legend — a long arrow 'envelope' and a half-length arrow 'crest' — while motion continues

beats.narration_text: So relative to the blob, the tagged crest slides steadily toward the rear.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So relative to the blob, the tagged crest slides steadily toward the rear.
beats.new_visual_element: the red dot visibly falling toward the back of the envelope
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: continue motion; the tagged dot drifts from the centre toward the trailing edge of the envelope

beats.narration_text: Fresh crests keep appearing at the front and melting away at the back.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Fresh crests keep appearing at the front and melting away at the back.
beats.new_visual_element: crests being born at the front edge and fading at the rear
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: continue motion long enough to see crests grow in at the leading edge and shrink out at the trailing edge

beats.narration_text: The crest speed is the phase velocity; the envelope's is twice it, the group velocity.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The crest speed is the phase velocity; the envelope's is twice it, the group velocity.
beats.new_visual_element: labels: phase velocity on the crest, group velocity on the envelope
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: slow/hold the motion and label the crest arrow 'phase velocity' and the envelope arrow 'group velocity = 2x'

beats.narration_text: What you see and measure is the blob — the particle rides the envelope, not the ripples.
beats.tts_normalized_text: What you see and measure is the blob — the particle rides the envelope, not the ripples.
beats.new_visual_element: the envelope highlighted and labelled 'the particle'
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: emphasise the envelope (thicken/glow) with a label 'the particle is here'; fade the crest emphasis; clean close
